summary: Points out problems that arise when DHCPv6 uses several stateful options at once, such as IA_NA for addresses and IA_PD for delegated prefixes. It recommends changes to how clients and servers handle them. It was replaced by RFC 8415.

eli5.summary: When you ask for two kinds of things on one order form, mistakes can happen. This says how to fill out and process the form so both requests work smoothly.
